name: valve_citadel_pod_line
note: The Citadel's zapper pod line (d3_citadel_01): seven prisoner pods hang on swinging arms from trains on a closed loop of rail over the pod bay's void; every few seconds all of them move on one stop together; at one stop each pod's lid opens and shuts, at another it passes through a caged energy field that crackles and zaps it

trigger.name: zapperpod_resume_relay
trigger.what: all pods move on one stop (it runs by itself; this kicks it if a pod was held up)
